E2-2024-T2-P1-S4.trunk: The trade body says these don't go far enough and fail to promote the benefits（行业组织说这些措施力度不足，也未能宣传益处）
structure: 现在分词短语〔时间背景〕：Coming at a time of fresh incentives from the UK government
└ 不定式复合结构〔说明 incentives〕：for landowners to grow more trees
└ 宾语从句〔省略that〕：these don't go far enough and fail to promote the benefits
└ of动名词短语〔修饰 benefits〕：of planting them to boost timber supplies
E2-2024-T2-P1-S4.logic: 句首Coming短语交代政策背景；主句的核心评价是并列的“不够”和“未能宣传”，末尾to boost说明植树的目的。
notes: these 指前文英国政府推出的 incentives。
go far enough 意为“力度足够、做得足够深入”。
them 指 trees，而不是 incentives。

E2-2024-T2-P1-S11.trunk: The focus of government support continues to be on A and B（政府支持的重点仍在A和B上）
structure: 让步状语从句(While)：While productive tree planting can deliver ... and contribute ...
└ 并列谓语：can deliver real financial benefits ... and contribute to the UK's net-zero strategy
主句：the focus of government support continues to be on food production and ... woodland
└ 并列宾语二：the rewilding and planting of native woodland solely for biodiversity
E2-2024-T2-P1-S11.logic: While建立“植树有经济和减排收益”与“支持重点仍另有所属”的让步转折；主句说明政府资源配置与前述收益并未对齐。
notes: productive tree planting 指以生产木材等实际产出为目标的植树。
rewilding 指让土地恢复更自然、少人工干预的生态状态。
solely for biodiversity 限定再野化和本土林地种植的政策目的。

E2-2024-T2-P1-S12.trunk: We need our land to provide supplies and contribute to net-zero（我们需要土地提供木材并助力净零）
structure: 让步状语从句(While)：While food production and biodiversity health are clearly of critical importance
└ 宾语补足语(to)：to also provide secure supplies of wood ... and contribute to net-zero
├ 并列谓语一：provide secure supplies of wood for construction, manufacturing
E2-2024-T2-P1-S12.logic: 先承认粮食和生物多样性的重要性，再用need + 宾语 + to do提出土地还应承担的两项功能，语气并非否定前者，而是要求兼顾。
notes: be of critical importance 等于 be critically important。
secure supplies 指稳定、有保障的供应。
net-zero 指温室气体净零排放目标。
